description: Clean Energy Employment Assessment Tool (CEEAT) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy efficiency, Renewable energy", published or maintained by Ashok Sarkar, Tu Chi Nguyen, Yao Zhao, Arslan Khalid (World Bank Group). CEEAT MS Excel-based and uses an input-output (I-O) table-based approach to estimate the economy-wide net direct, indirect and induced employment impacts of various clean energy technology pathways, with a focus on the electricity sector. Please note that the default setting is set to Morocco. Please enter data from your country of interest. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 2 files in XLSX, PDF. The portal files it under Energy efficiency, Renewable energy. The portal gives 2024 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
